steps.title: Material Feeding Part 2 of 2
steps.description:
Move roll stand into place so that the material will cover the full cut from the die mold. (Needs physical training)
Visually confirm that the edges of the material roll are centered on the conveyor belt.
Carefully remove the packing material, taking care not to damage the material.
This is the loaded die-mold.
The die mold will cut the material when the press head lowers during production.
The cutting area is here on the conveyor belt, directly below the die mold.
This is the cutting side of the die mold.
This is the cutting area of the die mold.
When loading the material onto the conveyor belt and moving it toward the front of the machine, make sure the material is centered and fully covering this cutting area.
This label contains the Thinsulate material lot number. Do not discard this label with the packing materials.
Remove the label, taking care not to tear it. This may damage the material. The damaged area will be discarded after production begins.
Temporarily place the material label here by the back side control switches.
Feed the material under the first clamp on the back side of the machine.
This is the first clamp.
For instructions on how to operate the clamps manually, see video "Clamp Manual Operation."
Using the control switches on the back side of the machine, move the material under the press head so that the leading edge of the material is fully covering the cut area of the die mold.
These are the control switches.
Bring the material label to the front of the machine.
Keep the label with the work order paperwork. You will write the material lot number on the work order.
This is the material.
This is the die mold cutting area (blue guides with blades in between).
The leading edge of the material is fully covering the cut area of the die mold, length-wise.
This is the material.
Confirm that the sides of the material are fully covering the cutting area.
This is the die mold cutting area (blue guides with blades in between).
On the right side, the material fully covers the cutting area.
On the left side, the material fully covers the cutting area.
The leading edge of the material fully covers the cutting area.
